title: Model parameter updating method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product

pse.problem: Risk of information leakage in current longitudinal federal learning scheme due to gradient exchange
pse.solution_function: A method for updating model parameters in a first device by calculating prediction loss, optimizing it, and sending the updated original model output to a second device for parameter update in the second model based on error between original and optimized model outputs.
pse.solution_structure: First and second devices in communication, each with a local model and capable of processing training data sets.
pse.solution_implementation: Calculating prediction loss using local model output and received original model output, optimizing prediction loss to update parameters, updating prediction loss based on updated first model and original model output, and updating original model output according to gradient value.
pse.effect: Reduction of information leakage risks in longitudinal federal learning
